evaluation_scope: Plan-only scenario checks. These do not prove a generated extension runs, nor measure automatic skill triggering.

evals.prompt: You are developing from a non-OMP coding harness. Plan a new OMP extension that browses project bookmarks with a keyboard picker and saves the selected bookmark. The user wants Nerd Icons when enabled and readable output when disabled. Only produce a concrete development and verification plan; do not implement or claim commands were run. The installed OMP version and its current icon API have not yet been checked.
evals.expected_output: Source-first target version investigation, native UI preference, live symbol preset handling including Unicode/ASCII, safe storage, actual OMP and visual verification without invented harness APIs.
assertions: Requires checking actual target version and source/types before selecting API
Uses resolved native theme symbols and respects Nerd, Unicode, and ASCII modes rather than forcing glyphs
Requires actual OMP TUI verification and does not claim it has already occurred

evals.prompt: An existing OMP tool broke after a host upgrade. Its execute implementation names arguments (id, params, onUpdate, ctx, signal), following an official old example. It works in some unit tests, and /reload-plugins says reloaded but old behavior remains. It is linked locally. Plan the smallest investigation/fix, version decision, and GitHub release/update workflow. Do not modify files or run commands; identify what must be checked.
evals.expected_output: Compare actual target types/wrapper with old positional signature, inspect runtime reload scope and restart when needed, avoid forced reinstalls for every edit, independently version extension, use correct GitHub source/ref and clean-install verification.
assertions: Verifies canonical execute signature instead of trusting old example or silencing types
Distinguishes linked source changes from process reload and does not trust reload banner alone
Separates extension release version from host version and gives OMP GitHub install syntax

evals.prompt: Port an OMP extension to pi only, not dual-host support. It imports @oh-my-pi/pi-tui and a deep settings module, uses pi.zod, ctx.models, theme.symbol and theme.getSymbolPreset(), and writes a custom footer. We have no installed pi version yet. Give a migration and verification plan, including local/GitHub installation and package-only updates. Do not implement or claim runtime tests passed.
evals.expected_output: Check current pi identity/version/exports and implementation, no automatic namespace-only port, real replacements for OMP-only APIs, pi-specific manifest/install/update syntax, native pi UI/icon investigation, independent runtime proof, no unnecessary dual adapter.
assertions: Inspects actual pi version/namespace and treats OMP-only APIs as requiring real alternatives
Chooses a single-target port without unnecessary dual-host compatibility scaffolding
Uses pi-specific package/install/update semantics and warns that bare pi update may update the host
